metadata.name: ai.quickdeploy/stripe-payments-operator
metadata.title: Stripe Payments Operator
metadata.description: Sandbox-safe Stripe payments operations with confirm-gated refunds and cancellations.

skill.name: stripe-payments-operator
skill.description: Operate Stripe payments from an agent with sandbox-safe defaults — inspect payments, customers, subscriptions, and webhooks via the Stripe CLI/API, and only touch money-moving operations with explicit confirmation.

destructiveOperations.name: refund-payment
destructiveOperations.description: Creates a full or partial refund against a captured charge.

destructiveOperations.name: cancel-subscription
destructiveOperations.description: Cancels a subscription immediately or at period end.

env.name: STRIPE_API_KEY
env.description: Stripe secret key; test keys (sk_test_*) by default.

env.name: STRIPE_LIVE_MODE
env.description: Set to 1 to explicitly opt into live-mode operations.
